svg.text: Suppliers peel, cut, blanch, dry, fry, and freeze potatoes.
Steam loosens the skin. Water and brushes remove it.
Loose skin goes to other uses or waste
Water carries each potato through cutting blades.
What happens next depends on the supplier.
Pressure, fast venting, water and brushes
Funnel and guides line up the potatoes
Pushers trim. Shaped blades make crinkle cuts
Sources: McDonald's, Lamb Weston, McCain, TOMRA, and Lamb Weston patents.
